author: SickProdigy
description: An experimental persistent two-player Magic: The Gathering rules prototype with private hands and curated starter decks.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs, active match state, private hands, decks, public game actions, and channel/message identifiers until the match record is deleted. User deletion removes matches involving that user.
install_msg: Start with `[p]mtg challenge @member`. This experimental version supports only its bundled starter decks and curated rules subset.
name: MTG
